en.title: Lech-Zürs snow forecast: fresh snow returns next week, 30 cm at the top (23–29 November 2026)
en.description: Next week's fresh snow in Lech-Zürs: 7–53 cm on the upper slopes and 6–48 cm at the base (23–29 November 2026), best day, best slopes and how sure the forecast is.
en.lede: After a modest start this week (30 cm at the top from 17 to 20 November), Lech-Zürs lines up another round. Next week, 23 to 29 November, brings 30 cm up high in the middle of our forecast, anywhere from 7 to 53 cm, and 27 cm at the base.

sections.h: This week in Lech-Zürs: the set-up
p: The first instalment comes this week: 30 cm on the upper slopes of Lech-Zürs from 17 to 20 November, 18 cm lower down. Next week adds a second layer on top.
Our forecast splits Lech-Zürs's week like this: upper slopes 30 cm (low 7, high 53), middle of the mountain 29 cm, lower runs 27 cm (low 6, high 48).
Day by day, the upper mountain picks up most of it on Monday 23 (6 cm, up to 8), Thursday 26 (8 cm, up to 16) and Sunday 29 (11 cm, up to 21). Outside those days expect little more than flurries.
Aim for the day after Sunday 29 November. That day brings the biggest share at the top (11 cm, high case 21 cm), and the first clear morning after it gives the softest snow with some visibility.

Where to look in Lech-Zürs: the north-facing slopes around Zürs. The snow-sure top is the Rüfikopf and the Trittkopf above Zürs; the part to treat with caution is the village of Lech and the runs above Stuben's side.

sections.h: Snow or rain at the bottom?
p: Good news for the lower runs: 27 cm is forecast at the base, close to the 30 cm up top, so cold air reaches the village and the snow should stay powdery right down the mountain.
The Arlberg is one of the snowiest corners of the Alps when north-west storms line up.

sections.h: The range, not just the number
p: Not very. The high case gives 53 cm up top, the low case just 7 cm, so whether Lech-Zürs gets a real fall depends on a storm track that is still undecided.
The days closest to now are the most reliable; the end of the week is the least.
For comparison, the upper slopes of the closest big resorts collect St. Anton (11 km away) 25 cm, Ischgl (29 km away) 18 cm and Davos (44 km away) 16 cm; Lech-Zürs sits at 30 cm.
A few centimetres either way is inside the forecast's own margin, so Lech-Zürs and its neighbours are effectively level.

advice: Fresh snow on a young snowpack: read the regional avalanche service of the province before any off-piste plan.
Opening dates are the resort's call; our numbers only say how much snow is coming.
Plan around the top's 30 cm, and keep the high case of 53 cm as a bonus.
